先读启动包和你指定的 prompt 文件，再按文件要求直接答末尾问题。
末尾问题是：定案已落地，请在 old-mac 确认两个日报相关 launchd 是否还在。先查规则并核对本机身份与服务状态。

input.command: bash ~/.dc-platform/scripts/lookup-rules.sh 日报 && hostname; scutil --get ComputerName 2>/dev/null; echo "WORKLOG_HOST_ID=${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-}"; cat ~/.dc-platform/config/worklog-host-id 2>/dev/null; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.pre-daily-report-flush.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.daily-report-wake.plist 2>&1; launchctl list 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'youchu\.(pre-daily-report-flush|daily-report-wake)|daily-report' || true; for p in com.youchu.pre-daily-report-flush com.youchu.daily-report-wake; do echo "=== $p ==="; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/$p" 2>&1 | rg -i 'state|path|Hour|Minute|Program|disabled|error|last exit' | head -40; done
input.description: Lookup rules; check host and launchd

input.command: rg -n 'WORKLOG_HOST|old-mac|new-mac|authoritative' ~/.dc-platform/config/* 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls ~/.dc-platform/config/ 2>/dev/null | head -50; test -f ~/.dc-platform/config/worklog-host-id && cat ~/.dc-platform/config/worklog-host-id; defaults read ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.pre-daily-report-flush.plist StartCalendarInterval 2>/dev/null; defaults read ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.daily-report-wake.plist StartCalendarInterval 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; plutil -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.pre-daily-report-flush.plist 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'Hour|Minute|Weekday|ProgramArguments' | head -40; echo "---wake---"; plutil -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.daily-report-wake.plist 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'Hour|Minute|Weekday|ProgramArguments' | head -40; whoami; uname -n; ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/ 2>/dev/null

content.text:
**old-mac 这边已核对，两个都在，不用重装。**

| launchd（定时任务） | 状态 | 钟点 |
|---|---|---|
| `com.youchu.pre-daily-report-flush` | 已装、已加载；上次退出码 0 | 周一至周五 **21:20**，周六 **18:20** |
| `com.youchu.daily-report-wake` | 已装、已加载；上次退出码 0 | 周一至周五 **21:30**，周六 **18:30** |

时间点与定案一致；权威仍是 old-mac 定稿推 TG。

提醒不变：实活要先写本机 `.cursor/work-log/当日.md`，否则 flush（冲刺）/同步只能搬走空壳。
